title: Rose with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="petalGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff6b8a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d42a4a"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="innerGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff8fa8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e8385c"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x="46" y="62" width="8" height="32" rx="4" fill="#3aad4a"/>
  <!-- leaf left -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="78" rx="14" ry="6" fill="#2e9e3e" transform="rotate(-20 30 78)"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="78" x2="16" y2="74" stroke="#267a32" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- leaf right -->
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="72" rx="12" ry="5" fill="#35b545" transform="rotate(15 70 72)"/>
  <line x1="70" y1="72" x2="82" y2="68" stroke="#288a36" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- outer petals -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="30" rx="22" ry="20" fill="url(#petalGrad)"/>
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="38" rx="16" ry="18" fill="#e63860" transform="rotate(-30 32 38)"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="38" rx="16" ry="18" fill="#e63860" transform="rotate(30 68 38)"/>
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="26" rx="15" ry="16" fill="#f05070" transform="rotate(-15 38 26)"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="26" rx="15" ry="16" fill="#f05070" transform="rotate(15 62 26)"/>
  <!-- inner petals -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="16" ry="14" fill="url(#innerGrad)"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="34" rx="10" ry="11" fill="#ff6b8a" transform="rotate(-10 40 34)"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="34" rx="10" ry="11" fill="#ff6b8a" transform="rotate(10 60 34)"/>
  <!-- center face area -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="11" fill="#ff9db3"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="38" rx="2.2" ry="2.8" fill="#5a1030"/>
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="38" rx="2.2" ry="2.8" fill="#5a1030"/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx="45.2" cy="37" r="0.8" fill="#ffd6e0"/>
  <circle cx="53.2" cy="37" r="0.8" fill="#ffd6e0"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M45 43 Q50 48 55 43" stroke="#5a1030" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="42" r="2.5" fill="#ff7a94" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="42" r="2.5" fill="#ff7a94" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
